_about: Every figure and line on the plan site, with its source and the date it was read. qa/sums.js recomputes every sum on the page from this file. build.js copies it into index.html so the page reads it offline too.

findings.line: The only order button on your site goes to Uber Eats.
The menu is two pictures and a PDF, so no price on the site can be tapped or added to an order.
The booking form asks for a time in Central European Time and never confirms the table.
Huddersfield isn’t on the site, though your post of 23 October says it’s open on King St.
